packages.title: Ayodhya Tour
packages.name: Ayodhya Tour
highlights: Darshan at the grand Ram Mandir
Evening Aarti at Saryu River Ghat
Visit to Hanuman Garhi and Kanak Bhawan
Guided spiritual walk through ancient Ayodhya
packages.overview: Experience the divine aura of Ayodhya, the birthplace of Lord Rama. This thoughtfully curated tour takes you through the most sacred temples, ancient ghats, and spiritual landmarks that define the spiritual heart of India.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Ayodhya & Evening Aarti
itinerary.description: Upon arrival, transfer to your premium hotel. In the evening, witness the mesmerizing Saryu River Aarti, a deeply spiritual experience with hundreds of floating diyas.

itinerary.title: Temple Trail & Ram Mandir Darshan
itinerary.description: Early morning visit to the magnificent Ram Janmabhoomi Temple. Later, explore Hanuman Garhi, Kanak Bhawan, and other significant sites associated with the Ramayana.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: After a wholesome breakfast, spend some free time for local shopping before departing with divine blessings.

inclusions: AC transportation for all transfers and sightseeing

packages.title: Golden Triangle India
packages.name: Golden Triangle India
highlights: Guided tour of Old and New Delhi
Sunrise visit to the iconic Taj Mahal
Elephant/Jeep ride at Amber Fort, Jaipur
packages.overview: Embark on a mesmerizing journey through India's Golden Triangle. Explore the bustling streets of Delhi, marvel at the timeless beauty of the Taj Mahal in Agra, and experience the royal heritage of Jaipur. This tour offers a perfect blend of history, culture, and architecture.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Delhi
itinerary.description: Welcome to India! Upon arrival in Delhi, transfer to your hotel. Rest and relax after your journey.

itinerary.title: Delhi Sightseeing
itinerary.description: Explore the historical wonders of Delhi, including Jama Masjid, Red Fort (outside), Raj Ghat, Qutub Minar, and India Gate.

itinerary.title: Delhi to Agra & Taj Mahal
itinerary.description: Drive to Agra. In the afternoon, visit the magnificent Agra Fort and enjoy a sunset view of the Taj Mahal from Mehtab Bagh.

itinerary.title: Sunrise at Taj Mahal & Drive to Jaipur
itinerary.description: Witness the Taj Mahal at sunrise. Later, drive to Jaipur, en route visiting the abandoned city of Fatehpur Sikri.

itinerary.title: Jaipur City Tour
itinerary.description: Visit the majestic Amber Fort, City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and take a photo stop at Hawa Mahal (Palace of Winds).

itinerary.title: Jaipur to Delhi
itinerary.description: Drive back to Delhi. Spend the evening at leisure or do some last-minute shopping in Connaught Place.

itinerary.title: Departure
itinerary.description: Transfer to Delhi airport for your onward journey with beautiful memories.

inclusions: Private AC vehicle for all transfers and sightseeing
Local English-speaking guides in each city

packages.title: Amritsar Tour
packages.name: Amritsar Tour
packages.overview: Amritsar was founded in 1577 by Ram Das, fourth Guru of the Sikhs, on a site granted by the Mughal emperor Akbar. Ram Das ordered the excavation of the sacred tank, or pool, called the Amrita Saras (“Pool of Nectar”), from which the city’s name is derived. A temple was erected on an island in the tank’s centre by Arjan, the fifth Guru of the Sikhs, which was then reached by a marble causeway. During the reign of Maharaja Ranjit Singh (1801–39), the upper part of the temple was decorated with a gold-foil-covered copper dome, and since then the building has been popularly known as the Golden Temple. Amritsar became the centre of the Sikh faith, and, as the focus of growing Sikh power, the city experienced a corresponding increase in trade. It was annexed to British India in 1849.

The most magnificent of the Kashmir trees is the Chinar found throughout the valley. It grows to giant size and girth. The trees presents itself in various enchanting colors through the cycle of the seasons among which its autumnal look is breath-taking. Mountain ranges in the Valley have dense deodar, pine and fir. Walnut, willow, almond and cider also add to the rich flora of Kashmir. 
Happy Valley,  Super Switzerland of Asia, Mughal Emperor's dream garden and Emerald amongst the white pearls of the Himalaya are only a few of the many appellations given to the valley of Kashmir, over the countries.
